author: Allman, 1877

note.en: A tiny feathery hydroid, up to 3 cm, that grows on algae and hard surfaces; the Limón record is a museum specimen and a DNA sample, and the stinging colonies are too small to notice.
note.es: Un hidroide plumoso diminuto, de hasta 3 cm, que crece sobre algas y superficies duras; el registro de Limón es un espécimen de museo y una muestra de ADN, y las colonias urticantes son demasiado pequeñas para notarlas.

evidence: GBIF: 2 records in the region (a GenBank-mined sample and an unlocated museum specimen near Limón)
Kelmo & Vargas 2002: their Costa Rican colonies are from the Pacific coast (Ocotal)

sources.t: Kelmo & Vargas 2002, Anthoathecatae and Leptothecatae hydroids from Costa Rica, Rev. Biol. Trop. 50(2)
